$comment: FSM Studio metrics snapshot at the v1.1.0 tag. Phase D.8 of the autonomy plan. Companion to the v1.0 baseline docs/metrics/2026-05-15.json (NOT overwritten). 'deltas_v1_0_to_v1_1' carries v1.0->v1.1 movement; 'attention:true' marks a metric the next status report must look at (the D.8 regression contract). Reproducible: every metric has a 'method'.

tag_topology.v1_1_0_tag_subject: docs(roadmap): mark v1.0 + v1.1 SHIPPED (post-tag status)
tag_topology.checkpoint_subject: docs: v1.1.0 gate-verification record (canonical release evidence)
tag_topology.note: Reconciliation of brief vs reality: the brief named abc7004 as 'the release commit'. abc7004 is in fact the gate-doc commit and the checkpoint/2026-05-15 anchor. The annotated v1.1.0 tag points one commit later at 9634c7e (the post-tag SHIPPED-status ROADMAP edit). The GATE doc's cold-from-source quad was run at the pre-gate-doc release commit eb35d4b. All three recorded so this snapshot is unambiguous. v1.0 baseline JSON is pinned at b480003; v1.0.0 tag itself is 13e2ac6.

tests.method: warm `cargo test --workspace` in the retro worktree (warm shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR, no rebuild); summed every 'test result: ok. N passed' line incl. unit + integration binaries; 8 doc-test binaries reported 0. Sum verified == 673 (matches GATE_VERIFICATION_v1_1 §4 cold-quad figure exactly). NOTE: a warm pass is necessary-not-sufficient for a TAG per §11.22 -- this snapshot only re-confirms the count; the authoritative cold-from-source 673/0 is the GATE doc's, not this run.

per_crate.method: unit-test binary attributed to its crate; integration-test binary attributed to the crate whose tests/ dir owns the .rs stem; sum reconciles to 673 with 0 unmapped.

loc.method: `find crates/<c>/src -name '*.rs' | xargs wc -l`. APPROXIMATE: this counts whole src/ files; inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` blocks living inside src/ files are NOT subtracted out (per-crate they are small relative to dedicated tests/ dirs). tests_dir_loc counts crates/<c>/tests/*.rs only, so the true test LOC is somewhat higher (inline unit mods excluded) and src is somewhat lower -- ratio is a lower bound. Method is identical to the v1.0 baseline's so the delta is apples-to-apples.

api_surface.method: STRICT = `grep -rhoE '\bpub(\(...\))? (fn|struct|enum|trait) '` in src/ minus pub(crate)/pub(super)/pub(in). BROAD = same plus const|type|mod|use|static (the v1.0 baseline's 878 used this broader family). Single-line-token method: multi-line `pub fn` whose signature wraps may undercount; the ARCH audit's ~765 used a third (rustdoc/AST-ish) method -- all three agree directionally.
api_surface.interpretation: NOT a v1.1 regression. On the comparable BROAD method the surface went 878 -> 826 (DOWN 52) DESPITE +6524 src LOC, because W3 collapsed the LoweringCtx god-object + dead-dep demotion. The ARCH audit's ~455 -> ~765 growth is the strict-method view of the same 15-wave feature surface (submachine epic, import-header, per-machine strategy, branch hints all add legitimately-public API). The `attention:true` flag is NOT 'this regressed this release' -- it marks the carried P1 (pub over-exposure; only a small fraction used cross-crate) that both the v1.0 baseline note and the v1.1 ARCH audit track as the standing v1.2-gate debt. D.8 contract: surface-this-metric-to-the-next-status-report. fsm-parser (230 strict / 280 broad) is the dominant over-exposer and the prime target of the recommended unreachable_pub/missing_docs cleanup wave.

mutation_density.method: mut_self = `grep -roE 'fn name(<...>)?\(\s*&mut self'` per crate src/. ratio = mut_self / all `fn name` in src/. AD-3 lowering metric = &mut self in any crates/*/src/lower/ dir.
mutation_density.interpretation: STRONG IMPROVEMENT, the AD-3 retrospective metric validated. v1.0 baseline = 278 mut-self (ratio 0.399, LoweringCtx super-struct = 27). v1.1 = 100 (ratio ~0.071). W3 eliminated the LoweringCtx god-object; the workspace lower/ dirs now hold just 1 &mut self method (the id-allocator in fsm-analyzer/src/lower/ids.rs, an intentionally-stateful counter) -- comfortably under the brief's expected 6 and far under the 27 baseline. The remaining mut-self concentrates where it is idiomatic & correct: fsm-lexer (24, cursor advance), fsm-parser (21, rowan builder), fsm-ir/fsm-simulator (builder + interpreter step). Architecturally healthy; no longer god-object-shaped.

conformance.method: AUTHORITATIVE source = tests/conformance/MANIFEST.json (`fsm test tests/conformance/` walks the manifest, NOT the dir tree). Raw filesystem dir-walk is misleading: parser/neg etc. are multi-case dirs, so `ls -d */` undercounts and a naive `find *.fsm` (26) overcounts vs the 25 the runner actually executes. GATE_VERIFICATION_v1_1 §4 cold-run = `tests/conformance/ 25/25`, consistent.
conformance.cgen_004_note: tests/conformance/codegen-c/004_guard_disambiguated_dispatch/ (source.fsm + expected/) -- added by W7-FU-1 (Doc 00 §11.26). The v1.0 baseline JSON already recorded conformance_fixtures:25 (it was authored mid-v1.1-W1, post-CGEN-004-era numbering); the gate doc text 'v1.0=24, v1.1=25 incl CGEN-004' describes the semantic addition. Net manifest total at this tag = 25, CGEN-004 included.

coverage_map_formal_vs_crate_split.note: tests/conformance/COVERAGE_MAP.md: 36/75 diagnostic codes have a formal tests/conformance fixture; the other 39 are covered by crate-level negative tests (not the formal harness). This is the SAME explicitly-tracked G7 partial accepted at the v1.0 gate -- NOT a v1.1 regression. The new v1.1 diagnostics (E0502, E0300/W0300, import-header, retired-E0903/defer) are each behaviourally tested in their wave's §5.4 suite even where the formal-harness row still says UNTESTED. Closure to 75/75 formal tracked for v1.1.x.

decisions_ledger.method: Counted `| §11.N |` rows in docs/00-Decisions-And-Reconciliation.md. Spot-confirmed every one of the last 11 (the v1.1 rows) names a real object: §11.19 7a69612/2384608/8b66dc2/af8c300+02d4ded, §11.20 3017c1c, §11.21 300d1e4, §11.22 e2e9294, §11.23 phase2.14/ob1-opaque-extern (branch exists), §11.24 e74888a, §11.25 phase2.16/w7-per-machine-strategy (branch exists), §11.26 d957d12, §11.27 41b9e46, §11.28 2b3d221, §11.29 W8 doc-honesty pass. All cited SHAs resolve via `git log --oneline`; all cited phaseN branches exist via `git branch`. v1.0 baseline had §11.1-§11.18 (18 rows); +11 for v1.1.

behavioural_acceptance_tests.total_files_invoking_gcc: 27 test files + 4 src-inline doctest-style helpers (dispatch_switch/dispatch_table/header/history emit + submachine.rs/util.rs scaffolds)
behavioural_acceptance_tests.method: BALLPARK. `grep -rl 'Command::new("gcc")|"gcc"' crates/*/tests` = 27 files; filtered to those that ALSO spawn/run the compiled artifact (gcc-compile-AND-RUN, the §5.4 'execute the binary + assert observable behaviour' bar) = 26 acceptance files + the shared common/mod.rs runner. Counted at file granularity, not per-test-case, hence 'ballpark'.
riskiest_wave_run_acceptance_tests: crates/fsm-cli/tests/guard_disambiguated_dispatch_e2e.rs (W7-FU-1, the P0-class dispatch fix, BOTH strategies, §11.26)
crates/fsm-cli/tests/import_header_e2e.rs (W5 + SEC-P0-1 -- legit end-to-end still passes post-hardening, §11.28)
crates/fsm-cli/tests/import_header_security.rs (SEC-P0-1 -- 17 attack-reject assertions; reject-shaped not gcc-RUN, the e2e RUN proof is import_header_e2e.rs)
crates/fsm-cli/tests/nested_submachine_no_broken_c.rs (P1-2 -- proves FSM-E0502 reject, no broken C emitted, §11.19/§11.29)
behavioural_acceptance_tests.interpretation: The §5.4 behavioural-acceptance mandate's coverage is broad and concentrated exactly on the v1.1 risk surface. This is the metric that operationalises the sprint's single highest-ROI process change (see retrospective).

safety.method: `grep -rl '#![forbid(unsafe_code)]' crates/<c>/src/`. CAVEAT a lib.rs-only grep yields 8/9 and is WRONG: fsm-cli is a binary crate whose crate-root attribute correctly lives in src/main.rs (not src/lib.rs). Scanning the actual crate root per crate confirms 9/9. The GATE doc + ARCH audit 9/9-through-15-waves claim is VERIFIED TRUE, not merely trusted.

gate_status.detail: GATE_VERIFICATION_v1_1 §1: G1-G6,G8 clean (G8 = cold-from-source 673/0). G7 (36/75 formal conformance) + G9 (remote CI never run, repo unpushed by design) are the SAME partials accepted at the v1.0 gate -- carried, documented, NOT v1.1 regressions. 0 open P0 (the one found, SEC-P0-1, fixed 2b3d221 + cold-quad-verified).

pre_tag_audit_outcome.note: The 3-lens pre-tag gate caught exactly ONE real P0 (SEC-P0-1) and ZERO overstated Doc-00 rows across a 15-wave surface; the pessimistic REL-P1-1 was a STALE audit claim (corrected to shipped FSM-E0502 reality, not propagated -- Doc 00 §11.29). Gate is well-calibrated: neither over- nor under-firing.

tests_total_passing.note: v1.0 baseline JSON value 495 (brief's ~491 is an estimate; the recorded baseline is authoritative). +178 across 15 waves, all with §5.4 gcc-RUN acceptance.

loc_src_excl_tests.note: +22% from submachine epic + import-header + per-machine strategy + branch hints + security hardening; proportionate to delivered surface.

api_surface_pub_broad.note: DOWN 52 on the comparable broad method despite +6524 LOC (W3 god-object collapse). attention:true = carried P1 over-exposure debt for the v1.2 gate, NOT a this-release regression. Strict-method snapshot 638; ARCH-audit method ~455->~765.

mutation_density_mut_self.note: AD-3 validated: -178 mut-self; ratio 0.399 -> 0.071; lowering dirs 27 -> 1. God-object eliminated.

conformance_fixtures.note: Manifest total flat at 25; CGEN-004 (W7-FU-1) is included. Semantic v1.0->v1.1 '24->25 incl CGEN-004' per GATE doc; baseline JSON already carried 25.

diagnostic_codes_formal_tested.note: G7 formal-harness coverage unchanged (carried partial); new v1.1 codes behaviourally tested in-wave per §5.4 even where the formal row is UNTESTED.

crates_forbid_unsafe.note: 9/9 held through all 15 v1.1 waves; verified via per-crate-root grep (fsm-cli root = main.rs).
